about: hi. tj. i run the poll. u know the one. pirates or ninjas. since 7th grade ive asked 1,014 people (incl. a substitute, a mailman, and a dog, invalid) and the tally stands at pirates 507, ninjas 499, unsolvable 1. i have never voted. a pollster who votes is just a guy with an opinion. the rules are posted: one vote per person per season, no shadow clones, no 'both,' no zombies (different poll), no changing it after lunch. everything goes in the ledger, a green hardcover from the office aisle at kroger, volume 3. i also own a katana. it opens mail. it says FIRST NATIONAL BANK on the handle. i know. i will explain.
aboutMore: how it works: i ask 1 question. u get a minute. i dont lead the witness. if u ask 'which would u pick' i say 'noted.' if u ask 'whos winning' i say pirates by 8. ninjas say 8 is inside the margin of error. i said i didnt calculate one. they said 'thats the point.' the best part is the second column: reason given. people say 'a ninja can be in a tree' and 'pirates get a parrot' and 'because it is.' i write all of it down. i know more about people from the reason column than from anything they say at lunch.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: one (1) actual ninja (i know. i know what i told ben. thats why im asking nicely) and one (1) actual pirate in the same room with a clipboard (randy wants this too, we are drafting the paperwork). a statistician. whoever picked the gift at first national for my pop-pop 38 years in a row, so i can say thank u. and whoever hasnt voted yet. u. u havent voted.

blog.title: WHY I NEVER VOTE (a statement) (its long)
blog.body: everybody asks. so here it is, once, in order. the poll started in 7th grade as a math project. 20 people. mr dobbs said pick a question people actually care about, so i picked the one the whole lunch room was already fighting about. respondent #1 was my pop-pop. he thought for a long time and said 'both. and he works at a bank.' i wrote down 'both.' mr dobbs said it has to be one. so i made rule 3, the rule i like least, and pop-pop is the reason it exists. 3 years later its 1,014 people. the answers are fine. the REASONS are the thing. 'parrot' means u like company. 'stealth' means u like to be left alone. 'treasure' means u like to find stuff. i could go down the ledger and tell u who u are. i wont. what i will say is, if i vote, half of u are on the other side, and then its a fight and not a question. i would rather be on everybodys side. so i hold the clipboard.

blog.title: THE KATANA (an inventory)
blog.body: devon is right. it is a letter opener. it says FIRST NATIONAL BANK on the handle and under that, smaller, MEMBER FDIC, which devon left out, and i think it matters. my pop-pop gene was a loan officer there for 38 years. every december the bank sent him one letter opener. some years they skipped. he has 31, all the same, in a folgers can in the garage. the day i turned 13 he took the can down, set it on the workbench and said 'pick one.' i picked the one with a dent in it from the time he dropped it on the driveway. he said every man needs one sharp thing and one thing to open mail with, and if youre lucky its the same thing. i named it the katana in 7th grade as a joke. now everybody does. it is 7 inches. not sharp. the cat sleeps on it. i use it every day at 2:14 when the mail comes, along the top, one pass. i have never cut a bill in half. the most useful sword i will ever own.
